newsitem.title: USA: Nets Inc launches business database service.
newsitem.headline: Nets Inc launches business database service.

text.p: Nets Inc said Tuesday it has launched a new service to allow business professionals to select, purchase and download new business leads and demographic data from the World Wide Web.

The new service is called New Business Leads. Nets Inc, which was formed in July when AT&T Corp merged its Internet new media service with the private company, Internet.Net. Nets Inc operates AT&T Business Network.
New Business Leads is designed to allow small- and medium-size business access information for use in direct marketing and sales campaigns, Nets Inc said.
New Business Leads is offered at three different membership levels: basic, professional and premier, the company said.
Exact pricing schedules were not disclosed. However, the company said subscribers can download names for as little as 10 cents a record.

It is offered in conjunction with MarketPlace Information Corp's D&B Marketplace CD-ROM product, which features Dun & Bradstreet's marketing database. MarketPlace Information is based in Waltham, Mass.
